rationale: S-0020-01 proposes an excitation-side sensitivity sweep under gabaMOD-swap on the deposited-DSGC port to close the 25 Hz peak-firing-rate gap. The deposited-DSGC line is retired in favour of the from-scratch substrate. The same AMPA-escape question is being answered on the from-scratch substrate via t0059. Reprioritising from high to medium.
